answer: Bind each agent to a refundable stake that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work across a long horizon of epochs. A fresh identity cannot simply wander into the trusted set: it starts near zero weight and must earn standing slowly, one attested task at a time. A clone fleet is no cheap zephyr of throwaway names, since each fake posts its own bond and waits its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount while one honest agent pays once.
